data.name: Areesah
data.gender_notes: Areesah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'arisah', meaning 'to give good news'. This name holds a spiritual significance in Islam, symbolizing the act of conveying blessings and positivity to others. The name Areesah carries the meaning “The Giver of Good Tidings” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Areesah usually hope their child will grow to embody the giver of good tidings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Areesah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Giver of Good Tidings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areesah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
